newsitem.title: UK: Bunzl shares at '97 high after acquisition.
newsitem.headline: Bunzl shares at '97 high after acquisition.

text.p: Shares in paper and plastics group Bunzl Plc matched their 1997 high on Friday, lifted by its purchase of a Unisource Worldwide Inc grocery division, market sources said.
Recent weakness in sterling and a positive comment on paper and pulp prices in the Financial Times also helped the shares.
By 0839 GMT, Bunzl shares were up 5p at 232p, bringing its rally since August 6 to nearly 20 percent.
"The whole sector is pretty bullish," one trader said.

The paper and packaging sector, and other second-tier stocks sensitive to sterling's strength, has rallied since the Bank of England hiked interest rates last week but signalled that they may be on hold for now.
On Friday, Bunzl said it had agreed to buy the grocery supply systems division and other related grocery supply business from Unisource Worldwide for about $88 million.
The business supplies disposable products to supermarkets and other grocery outlets in the U.S. and has annual sales in excess of $300 million.
